integrity: The general formula is proved by the image/kernel decomposition forced by the group inverse, orbit-stabilizer counting of free direct-sum decompositions, and reduction of general linear groups modulo the maximal ideal. Exhaustive computation is used only to stress-test the theorem on two nonisomorphic four-element local rings. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative local rings only. The scalar rank is the free rank of the image direct summand. No claim is made for nonlocal rings without replacing rank by a rank vector, or for Drazin index greater than one. A residual literature risk remains for terminology-mismatched finite-semigroup enumerations.
title: Uniform group-invertible lifting over finite local matrix rings
